column4: 这个故事里有三个主要人物。
column5: There are three main characters in this story.
column6: 人物 is a character in a story or an important person: 主要人物 (a main character), 重要人物 (an important figure), 历史人物 (a historical figure).

column5: The pain was so bad that he could not help crying.
column6: 忍 is to put up with something: 忍着 (to bear it), 忍不住 (cannot help doing), 忍一忍 (to hold on a little).

column5: The teacher teaches us to recognise characters.
column6: 认 is to recognise (认字, 认人) or to admit (认错, to admit a mistake). 认识 is "to know someone".

column5: A calendar is hanging on the wall.
column6: 日历 is a calendar: 一本日历, 看日历 (to look at the calendar), 手机日历 (a phone calendar).

column5: This shop sells all kinds of daily necessities.
column6: 日用品 are things used every day: 买日用品 (to buy daily goods), 日用品商店 (a daily goods shop).

column4: 这里有很多水果，如苹果、香蕉和西瓜。
column5: There is a lot of fruit here, such as apples, bananas and watermelons.
column6: 如 means "such as" before examples: 如苹果 (such as apples). In 如果 it means "if", in 如何 "how", and in 不如 "not as good as".

column5: Things are not so simple.
column6: 如此 means "like this" or "so": 如此简单 (so simple), 就是如此 (that is how it is), 不过如此 (it is nothing special). It is written style; 这样 is spoken.

column5: How should this matter be solved?
column6: 如何 means "how" in formal writing: 如何学习汉语 (how to learn Chinese), 如何解决 (how to solve it). 怎么 is the everyday word.

column4: 如今，很多人都用手机付钱。
column5: Nowadays, many people pay with their phones.
column6: 如今 means "now, these days" and looks back at the past: 如今不一样了 (it is different now).

column5: He is like family to me.
column6: 如同 means "to be like" and compares two things: 如同亲人 (like family), 如同……一样 (just like). It is more formal than 像.

column4: 开会的时间如下：明天上午九点。
column5: The time of the meeting is as follows: nine tomorrow morning.
column6: 如下 means "as follows" and introduces a list: 要求如下 (the requirements are as follows), 内容如下 (the content is as follows).

column5: This bed is very soft.
column6: 软 means soft: 软床 (a soft bed), 软的 (a soft one). The opposite is 硬.

column4: 可以用这个软件学汉语。
column5: You can use this software to study Chinese.
column6: 软件 is software: 用软件 (to use software), 新软件 (new software), 学习软件 (study software). 软件 is one word; 件 is not the measure word here.

column5: His body is weak.
column6: 弱 means weak: 身体弱 (a weak body), 弱小 (small and weak). The opposite is 强.

column5: The water spilled on the floor.
column6: 洒 is to spill or sprinkle: 洒水 (to sprinkle water), 洒出来 (to spill out).

column5: The athletes walked into the arena.
column6: 赛场 is the place where a match is held: 赛场上 (on the field), 走进赛场 (to enter the arena). 比赛 is the match itself.

column5: The colours of this picture are very beautiful.
column6: 色彩 is the colour seen in a picture, clothing or place: 色彩丰富 (rich in colour). 颜色 is the everyday word for "colour".

column5: It rarely rains in the desert.
column6: 沙漠 is a desert: 在沙漠里 (in the desert), 大沙漠 (a big desert). 沙 means sand.

column5: The children are playing on the sand.
column6: 沙子 is sand: 海边的沙子 (the sand by the sea), 沙子里 (in the sand).

column5: Do not do anything foolish.
column6: 傻 means foolish or silly: 傻事 (a foolish thing), 傻孩子 (a silly child, said fondly), 别傻了 (do not be silly).

column3: to dry in the sun; to sunbathe
column5: She dries the clothes in the yard.
column6: 晒 is to dry something in the sun or to sunbathe: 晒衣服 (to dry clothes in the sun), 晒太阳 (to bask in the sun).

column5: I deleted this character.
column6: 删 is to delete words or files: 删掉 (to delete), 删字 (to delete a character). 删除 is the more formal word.

column5: He is so hot that he keeps fanning the air.
column6: 扇 (shān) is to fan: 扇风 (to fan the air), 扇扇子 (to wave a fan). As a noun it is read shàn, as in 扇子 (a fan).

column5: Please do not delete these photos.
column6: 删除 is to delete files, messages or content: 删除照片 (to delete photos), 删除信息 (to delete a message). 删 is the short form.

column5: He works as a teacher in a mountain area.
column6: 山区 is a region of mountains: 山区的孩子 (children of the mountains), 在山区 (in the mountain area).

column3: to be good at (+ a skill or subject)
column5: She is good at drawing.
column6: 擅长 means to be good at a skill: 擅长数学 (good at maths), 擅长唱歌 (good at singing). It is more formal than 会.

column5: She is a kind-hearted person.
column6: 善良 means kind and good by nature: 善良的人 (a good-hearted person), 心地善良 (kind-hearted).

column3: to be good at (+ a verb; written)
column5: He is good at telling stories.
column6: 善于 means to be good at doing something, and is followed by a verb: 善于学习 (good at learning), 善于表达 (good at expressing). 擅长 can also be followed by a noun.

column4: 夏天，奶奶常常拿着一把扇子。
column5: In summer, Grandma often holds a fan.
column6: 扇子 is a hand fan: 一把扇子, 扇扇子 (to wave a fan).

column5: He has an injury on his leg.
column6: 伤 is an injury (noun) and to hurt (verb): 受伤 (to be injured), 伤心 (to be sad, with a hurt heart).

column5: Smoking can harm the body.
column6: 伤害 is to harm someone's body or feelings: 伤害别人 (to hurt others), 伤害身体 (to harm the body).

column5: Many shops cut prices during the festival.
column6: 商家 is a shop or business that sells goods: 商家打折 (a seller offers a discount), 网上商家 (an online seller). 商人 is a person who does business.

column5: He is a successful businessman.
column6: 商人 is a person in business: 一位商人 (a businessman), 小商人 (a small trader).

column5: This is a business trip.
column6: 商务 is business affairs between companies: 商务会议 (a business meeting), 商务旅行 (a business trip). It is formal; 生意 is everyday business.

column4: 这个城市的商业很发达。
column5: Commerce is very developed in this city.
column6: 商业 is commerce and trade: 商业街 (a shopping street), 商业活动 (business activity).

column5: Everyone goes to the park together to enjoy the flowers.
column6: 赏 is to look at something beautiful with pleasure: 赏花 (to enjoy flowers), 赏月 (to admire the moon), 欣赏 (to appreciate).

column4: 他把照片上传到了网上。
column5: He uploaded the photo to the internet.
column6: 上传 is to upload: 上传照片 (to upload photos), 上传作业 (to upload homework).

column3: to rise; to go up (numbers, temperature)
column5: The temperature is rising slowly.
column6: 上升 is to go up, for numbers, levels and temperature: 价格上升 (prices rise), 温度上升 (the temperature rises). The opposite is 下降.

column5: This child is about ten years old.
column6: 上下 means "up and down" (上下楼, to go up and down the stairs) and "about" after a number: 三十岁上下 (about thirty), 一百元上下 (around one hundred yuan).

column4: 最近，水果的价格上涨了。
column5: Recently, the price of fruit has gone up.
column6: 上涨 is to rise, mainly for prices: 价格上涨 (prices go up), 上涨了很多 (rose a lot). The opposite is 下降.

column5: He has a fever.
column6: 烧 means to burn (烧火, to make a fire), to cook by simmering (烧菜) and fever (发烧).

column5: We are going to have a barbecue this weekend.
column6: 烧烤 is a barbecue, food grilled over fire: 吃烧烤 (to eat barbecue), 烧烤店 (a barbecue restaurant).

column5: There is a snake on the grass.
column6: 蛇 is a snake: 一条蛇. It is also one of the twelve zodiac animals (生肖).

column3: to be reluctant to part with
column5: I am reluctant to leave this place.
column6: 舍不得 is to be reluctant to give up or leave: 舍不得走 (not wanting to go), 舍不得花钱 (hating to spend money). 舍得 is the positive form.

column3: to be willing to part with
column5: He is willing to spend money on his child.
column6: 舍得 is to be willing to give up or spend: 舍得花钱 (willing to spend money). It is often used in questions or with a negative: 舍不得.

column5: The equipment at this school is very good.
column6: 设备 is equipment: 新设备 (new equipment), 学习设备 (learning equipment), 设备很好 (the equipment is good).

column5: He designed this house.
column6: 设计 is to design (verb) or a design (noun): 设计师 (a designer), 服装设计 (fashion design), 设计很好 (a good design).

column4: 公司设立了一个新部门。
column5: The company has set up a new department.
column6: 设立 is to set up an organisation or office: 设立公司 (to set up a company), 设立办公室 (to set up an office).

column4: 我们社区有一个小公园。
column5: Our neighbourhood has a small park.
column6: 社区 is a community, the area where people live together: 社区活动 (community activities), 社区服务 (community service). 小区 is a housing estate.

column5: There are many sports facilities here.
column6: 设施 is facilities and installations: 体育设施 (sports facilities), 公共设施 (public facilities).

column5: He is very interested in photography.
column6: 摄影 is photography: 摄影师 (a photographer), 摄影比赛 (a photo competition), 学摄影 (to study photography).

column4: 请在手机上设置新的密码。
column5: Please set a new password on the phone.
column6: 设置 is to set up or configure: 设置密码 (to set a password), 手机设置 (phone settings).

column5: The child stretches out a hand to take a sweet.
column6: 伸 is to stretch out: 伸手 (to reach out a hand), 伸出来 (to stretch out), 伸腿 (to stretch the legs).

column5: She has a very good figure.
column6: 身材 is the shape of a person's body: 身材好 (a good figure), 身材瘦 (a slim build).

column5: The depth of this lake is ten metres.
column6: 深度 is depth: 水的深度 (the depth of the water), 深度十米 (ten metres deep). As an adjective it means "deep": 深度思考 (deep thinking).

column5: His identity is very special.
column6: 身份 is a person's identity or position: 学生身份 (student status), 身份证 (an ID card).

column4: 他们之间有很深厚的感情。
column5: There is a deep bond between them.
column6: 深厚 describes deep, strong feelings: 深厚的感情 (deep feelings), 深厚的友谊 (deep friendship).

column4: 这次旅行给我留下了深刻的印象。
column5: This trip left a deep impression on me.
column6: 深刻 means deep and strong, about impressions and thinking: 深刻的印象 (a deep impression), 理解深刻 (a deep understanding).

column4: 我们要深入了解这个问题。
column5: We need to understand this question in depth.
column6: 深入 is to go deep into something: 深入了解 (to understand in depth), 深入研究 (to study deeply).

column4: 这件事对社会有深远的影响。
column5: This matter has a far-reaching influence on society.
column6: 深远 means deep and far-reaching: 深远的影响 (a far-reaching influence), 意义深远 (of deep significance).

column4: 他给孩子们讲神话故事。
column5: He tells the children myth stories.
column6: 神话 is a myth: 神话故事 (a myth story), 中国神话 (Chinese myths). 神 is a god.

column4: 这个地方让人觉得很神秘。
column5: This place feels very mysterious.
column6: 神秘 means mysterious: 神秘的人 (a mysterious person), 神秘的地方 (a mysterious place), 感到神秘 (to feel mysterious).

column3: to rise; to go up (the sun, a flag)
column5: The sun has risen from the east.
column6: 升 is to rise: 升起来 (to rise up), 升高 (to rise in height), 升级 (to upgrade). It is also a litre: 一升水 (a litre of water).

column5: This factory produces computers.
column6: 生产 is to produce goods: 生产汽车 (to produce cars), 提高生产 (to raise production).

column5: Without water, animals cannot survive.
column6: 生存 is to survive or live: 生存下去 (to live on), 生存条件 (conditions for survival). 生活 is daily life; 生存 is about staying alive.

column5: The teacher tells it very vividly.
column6: 生动 means vivid and lively in telling or writing: 生动的故事 (a vivid story), 讲得生动 (told vividly).

column5: My phone needs to be upgraded.
column6: 升级 is to upgrade or go up a level: 手机升级 (a phone upgrade), 软件升级 (a software upgrade), 游戏升级 (to level up in a game).

column3: to warm up; to heat up
column5: The weather has started to warm up.
column6: 升温 is to rise in temperature, or to become more intense: 天气升温 (the weather warms up), 升温很快 (to warm up quickly).

column5: There are many living things on earth.
column6: 生物 means living things and also biology as a subject: 生物课 (a biology class), 不同的生物 (different living things).

column5: What is your Chinese zodiac animal?
column6: 生肖 is the zodiac animal of the year you were born, one of twelve: 十二生肖 (the twelve zodiac animals), 你的生肖 (your zodiac animal).

column4: 这种花在北方也能生长。
column5: This kind of flower can also grow in the north.
column6: 生长 is to grow, for plants and animals: 生长在北方 (to grow in the north), 生长很快 (to grow fast).

column5: China has more than thirty provinces.
column6: 省份 is a province: 哪个省份 (which province), 一个省份 (a province). The capital of a province is 省会.

column5: The capital of this province is very big.
column6: 省会 is a provincial capital: 省会城市 (a provincial capital city). 首都 is the national capital.

column5: In this match, our team won.
column6: 胜 is to win: 胜了 (won), 取胜 (to win), 胜过 (to be better than). It is mostly used in words such as 胜利.

column4: 我们取得了比赛的胜利。
column5: We achieved victory in the match.
column6: 胜利 is victory (noun) and to win (verb): 取得胜利 (to achieve victory), 胜利了 (we won).

column5: He likes reading ancient Chinese poems.
column6: 诗 is a poem: 一首诗 (a poem), 古诗 (an ancient poem), 写诗 (to write poems), 诗人 (a poet).
